propositions: review-plan computes PASS (signable: True) but signing aborts with store-read-failure (retryable: false) under concurrent store writes, leaving status stale-reopened and blocking non-force close

sign_manifest's generation loop treats transient store-read-failure from pre-lock reads (tracker_head_sha/collect) as terminal, while the sibling moving-HEAD transient is retried and only becomes retryable after MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS exhaustion

a peer session's in-flight git add→commit of tracked entries on the shared .git/index causes git status --untracked-files=no to report non-empty staged state, triggering store-read-failure in pre-lock reads that lack the store write lock

the fix retries store-read-failure within the existing MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS loop (continue) and surfaces it as PlanReviewGenerationRetryable only after exhaustion, while deterministic PlanRelationSnapshotError reasons remain terminal
under-lock re-check (run while holding the store write lock) remains the authoritative fence and ensures retrying pre-lock reads is safe against concurrent writers mid add→commit
